primary_questions: Does public_2N improve functional correctness over public_N?
Does fixed training depth outperform public_N on larger inputs?
Does extending N16 inference beyond trained depth destroy established chain competence?
queries: Exact saved E27 evaluation graphs and labels; all tasks, sizes and families retained. This is a causal depth diagnostic on existing queries, not a fresh benchmark or new training.
supervision: None. Correct answers only score completed predictions. No intermediate hints, gold stopping times or per-query depth selection.
model_state: All twelve final E27 checkpoints, including failed source arms. No training, normalization updates, memory edits or checkpoint selection.
accounting: Execute each fixed depth once per source/query cell. Primary policies reuse those recorded results, with their own deployable per-query costs; do not count aliases as additional executed work. Charge the full diagnostic grid separately.
verification: Source checkpoint/data hashes must match E27; original inference budget must reproduce every E27 final prediction exactly. Loaded checkpoint contents, model weights, global torch/CUDA RNG and source files remain unchanged. Preserve all predictions and source identities.
scope: No depth picked using correct answers is a candidate capability. Depth comparisons can expose harmful extra recurrence but cannot fully distinguish unstable learned dynamics, optimization or representational limitations. No broad reasoning or RSI claim follows.
preflight: Use the separate E27 functional-preflight sources with all four arms, reduced grid [2,8,16,32], and original source checks. Scored seeds are never used to choose the protocol.
